nodes.description: Owner address state variable, set to msg.sender in constructor and used for privileged withdrawals and selfdestruct.
Mapping of player address to accumulated winning balance; incremented in calcWinner and drained in userWithdraw.
Current game round counter, initialized to 1 and incremented when a round completes.
Number of registered participants in the current round, bounded by 8 and reset on round change.
Mapping of round to fixed array of 15 participant addresses used for matchmaking and randomness.
Constructor setting owner = msg.sender, round = 1 and registered = 0.
Owner-only function transferring an arbitrary amount of contract balance to owner.
Owner-only function calling selfdestruct(owner), destroying the contract.
View getter returning the current round number.
View getter returning the participant array for a given round index.
View getter returning the recorded withdrawal balance of a player.
Public withdrawal function zeroing the caller balance before sending ether to msg.sender.
Payable registration function requiring 105 finney, storing participants and triggering winner calculation at fixed milestones.
Private function choosing a winner pseudo-randomly from blockhash plus participant addresses and crediting the reward.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, registration, withdrawal and ether transfer.
External ether transfer owner.transfer(amount) performing a low-level send to the owner account.
selfdestruct(owner) permanently destroys the contract and forwards all balance.
External ether transfer msg.sender.transfer(amount) sending funds to the untrusted caller.
Pseudo-random number derived from blockhash(block.number - 1) and participant addresses, miner-influenceable.
Arithmetic accumulation withdrawals[participant] += reward that can overflow the uint balance.
Amount parameter of ownerWithdraw forwarded to owner.transfer.
Round index parameter of publicGetParticipants used to select the participant array.
Player address parameter of publicGetBalance used to index the withdrawals mapping.
Index of the first participant in calcWinner.
Index of the second participant in calcWinner.
Index at which the winning participant is stored in calcWinner.
Reward amount credited to the winner in calcWinner.
Local variable holding withdrawals[msg.sender] before the userWithdraw transfer.
Local pseudo-random value computed in calcWinner from blockhash and participants.

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender, granting privileges to the deployer.
whenOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownerWithdraw executes.
whenOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownerDestroy executes.
amount parameter is passed directly to owner.transfer.
ownerWithdraw triggers the owner.transfer external call.
owner.transfer performs an external send that could re-enter before completion if owner is a contract.
ownerDestroy executes selfdestruct, a privileged destructive operation.
selfdestruct sends the contract balance to the owner state variable.
msg.sender receives the ether transfer, enabling re-entrant calls from an attacker contract.
transfer amount is read from the withdrawals[msg.sender] balance mapping.
userWithdraw executes msg.sender.transfer as its final external call.
local amount copied from withdrawals is used as the transfer value.
external ether transfer can re-enter userWithdraw before the caller's accounting is finalized.
require(withdrawals[msg.sender] > 0) gates withdrawal on caller-controlled identity.
userRegister calls calcWinner at registration milestones 1, 3, 5 and 7.
calcWinner derives its winner from blockhash-based pseudo-randomness controlled by the miner.
participant addresses from the participants mapping are folded into the randomness input.
calcWinner increments the winner balance inside the withdrawals mapping.
withdrawals mapping entry is updated with an accumulated reward value.
reward parameter is added to the existing balance, allowing overflow of the uint counter.
userRegister stores the caller-controlled msg.sender as a participant.
userRegister writes participant addresses into the participants mapping.
registered counter controls registration flow and winner-calculation branches.
round state variable indexes the participants array during registration.
msg.sender is written into participants[round][registered].
round selects the participant array slot in the participants mapping.
publicGetRound returns the round state variable.
publicGetParticipants returns an array from the participants mapping.
index parameter selects which participant array is returned.
publicGetBalance reads the withdrawals mapping.
player parameter indexes the withdrawals mapping return value.
first index parameter selects a participant inside calcWinner.
second index parameter selects the opposing participant inside calcWinner.
winner index parameter determines where the winning address is stored.
reward parameter determines the amount credited to the winner.
constructor initializes owner with msg.sender privileges.
constructor initializes round to 1.
constructor initializes registered to 0.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed ownerWithdraw's transfer and should be merged into that function.
The index parameter is a transient selector used only by publicGetParticipants.
The player parameter is a transient lookup key used only by publicGetBalance.
The first index parameter is only meaningful inside calcWinner's participant selection.
The second index parameter is only meaningful inside calcWinner's participant selection.
The winner index parameter is only used to store the selected participant in calcWinner.
The reward parameter is only used to credit the winner inside calcWinner.
The local cached withdrawal amount is consumed directly by the msg.sender.transfer unsafe operation.
The local random value is the result of the blockhash-based randomness computation.
